notes.title: Update 1.2: 10 new cards!
notes.content:
10 NEW CARDS:
ABSORBED POWER [1]: Deal 4 damage. While this card is in your hand, add +1 damage for each two cards activated.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/3e9c3270f9bde31acb65b68bc8f9ef925e2d5847.png[/img]BUFF [1.5]: Add +2 damage to the 2 other cards in your hand.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/384050bd9a5aaceef5e1d68295bf0a7c3750a9a1.png[/img]COMBO [1.25]: Deal 4 damage. If used just after other card, deal +2 damage.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/7bac62d813601f9a124cbc323e60a0f25fd93294.png[/img]MARK [1]: For 3 seconds, the opponent will take  50% more damage.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/b4ad6e9fa50d0dfa7c9aab7850107161231d1bac.png[/img]OVERCHARGE [1]: Deal 4 damage to self. Add 3 random cards to your deck.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/afbe667b91f731a64424c6ad30219507a09e6958.png[/img]RANDOM [-0.25]: Becomes a random card when a battle starts. Has cast time reduced by 0.25s.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/867ebfef58cb4dc848ea4244d99ce0aa5a7403ca.png[/img]REVERSAL [1]: Deal back the damage you receive during casting phase.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/6da6bb3b8f950c82c50b41ef52981e3cd63ef7d3.png[/img]SLOW [1.75]: Deal 5 damage. Give Slowed card to your opponent.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/1001adc9636057ba3ff4cbf2beb06b8f6c68cf75.png[/img]SLOWED [2]: Waste 2 seconds. If discarded, freeze opponent for 3 seconds.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/d4a179adaa47157271690355681ad9327a41b0bc.png[/img]VAMPIRIC [2]: Deal 3 damage. Restore Health equivalent to damage dealt.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/b679bd5404711aa9319287f0739099ac393f4b0b.png[/img]VULNERABLE [2]: Deal 12 damage. You take double the damage during casting phase.

NIGHTMARE MODE:
 - 10 new enemies received the new cards.

ENGINE:
- Upgraded from Unreal engine 4.10 to 4.14

PICK A CARD:
- Improved algorithm to include more interesting cards;
- Can now have up to 4 card options.

FIXED BUGS:
- Strong should not activate twice.
- Fixed Linux Achievements.
- Fixed VR startup.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - 11 new cards, 10 updated enemies and a new Heroic Mode Campaign!
notes.content:
Dear Cultists,

The first big FREE content update has arrived our world!
Beware! I, Cthulhu, the greatest, crafted 11 new cards of madness for all my 9 minions and now I challenge you for a rematch!
After you complete the game once, you'll automatically enter the Heroic Mode, where you'll face stronger foes equipped with the new cards in a new level generator with 9 new quests to unlock 6 cards, 3 HP bonuses and unlock a third option on the pick a card screen!


[b]Here are all the new cards [/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/61684023720c4344d62285cf14c23c8989ff7302.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/b2de558a170f4188cef772a1b4ec7460988bdb2e.jpg[/img]

Some cards are exclusive to bosses and enemies:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/d651c54e26db6ecf3800fa5e55372c1ad52eca4e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26497012/85b29d0f8414114297c38f2c6e508e04e5e61dba.jpg[/img]


[b]Changes to old cards[/b]
Sacrificial - Damage adjusted from 6 to 7;
Shadow Bomb - Damage adjusted from 5 to 6;
Burn - Cast time adjusted from 1.25 to 0.75;
Venom - Cast time adjusted from 1.5 to 1;


[b]Feedback [/b]

I want to know if you liked the new update and want to see more updates following the same recipe.
If you have ideas for new cards, please post them here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/536040/discussions/0/341537388314854882/
